fees.notes: Official international fees where published: bachelor's RM50,800-RM60,750 total; diplomas RM22,000-RM28,810; master's RM24,670-RM28,850. Several programmes publish no international fee. Source: https://www.uptm.edu.my/ programme pages (checked 2026-09-18).

description: Universiti Poly-Tech Malaysia (UPTM) is a private university located in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. The university focuses on business, technology, computing, multimedia, and professional studies, with an emphasis on innovation, ethics, and industry-ready education. It offers Foundation, Diploma, Bachelor’s, and Postgraduate programs for local and international students.
